title: Learning rate is too high
body: Each update overshoots the minimum, so the loss bounces or grows instead of settling. Lower the learning rate about 10x; for Adam, 1e-3 is a safe start.

citation.label: Smith, Cyclical Learning Rates (LR range test), WACV 2017

guidingQuestion: What happens to Adam's steps when the learning rate is large compared with the curvature of the loss?
